use opentelemetry::trace::TracerProvider as _;
use opentelemetry_proto::tonic::collector::trace::v1::ExportTraceServiceRequest;
use opentelemetry_proto::transform::common::tonic::ResourceAttributesWithSchema;
use opentelemetry_proto::transform::trace::tonic::group_spans_by_resource_and_scope;
use opentelemetry_sdk::trace::{InMemorySpanExporter, SdkTracerProvider};
use prost::Message;
use tracing::field;
use tracing_subscriber::layer::SubscriberExt;

fn main() {
    let exporter = InMemorySpanExporter::default();
    let provider = SdkTracerProvider::builder()
        .with_simple_exporter(exporter.clone())
        .with_resource(opentelemetry_sdk::Resource::builder().with_service_name("kura").build())
        .build();
    let tracer = provider.tracer("kura");
    let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry().with(tracing_opentelemetry::layer().with_tracer(tracer));
    tracing::subscriber::with_default(subscriber, || {
        // Kura-style request span: an Empty field recorded on two paths.
        let request = tracing::info_span!("request", otel.name = "GET /up", otel.kind = "server",
            http.response.status_code = field::Empty, kura.result = field::Empty);
        {
            let _g = request.enter();
            request.record("http.response.status_code", 403u64);
            tracing::info!(target: "kura", status = 403, "denied");
            request.record("http.response.status_code", 200u64);
            request.record("kura.result", "ok");
        }
        drop(request);
        // A span with an ordinary field recorded once.
        let ok = tracing::info_span!("lookup", kura.store.result = field::Empty);
        ok.record("kura.store.result", "hit");
        drop(ok);
    });
    provider.force_flush().unwrap();
    let spans = exporter.get_finished_spans().unwrap();
    let resource = ResourceAttributesWithSchema::from(provider_resource());
    let request = ExportTraceServiceRequest { resource_spans: group_spans_by_resource_and_scope(spans, &resource) };
    std::fs::write(std::env::args().nth(1).unwrap(), request.encode_to_vec()).unwrap();
}

fn provider_resource() -> &'static opentelemetry_sdk::Resource {
    Box::leak(Box::new(opentelemetry_sdk::Resource::builder().with_service_name("kura").build()))
}
